checks.after: Huang said, “Moqian Hun’s extravagance and jealousy are already extreme; now then we can fight.”
checks.reason: 奢忌已甚 is extravagance and jealousy already extreme, not ‘arrogance has peaked’; 今則可一戰矣 is now one can fight. Replacement is faithful and keeps Huang as speaker.

checks.after: Yuwen Gui sent his cavalry general Sheyiyu to hold Murong Han with the whole host; Huang sent word at a gallop: “Sheyiyu is fierce and bold; you ought to avoid him a little, wait until the bandits grow arrogant, then take them.”
checks.reason: Current EN drops 騎將 and 盡眾, renders 小避之 as ‘spar lightly’ (wrong: give way a little), and loses 馳遣 and 虜勢驕. Replacement restores all, keeps Huang’s quotation to Han, and matches the alternative diagnosis.

checks.after: Sheyiyu vainly has an empty name; in truth he is easy to deal with; we ought not to loose the enemy and blunt our army’s spirit.”
checks.reason: 易與 is easy to deal with, not ‘brittle’; 不宜縱敵挫吾兵氣 means we should not let the enemy loose and blunt our army’s spirit. Replacement is faithful and keeps the closing quote of Han’s speech.
